scope: OpenRouterAgentRunner experiments through the certified-incumbent consumed-case qualification batch

finding.summary: The schedule seed is recorded as episode identity metadata but is not forwarded to OpenRouter model requests.
finding.schedule_behavior: experiments/run_envsolve_pro_v2_schedule.py passes each non-null schedule seed to run_envsolve_pro_v2_case.py with --seed.
finding.run_identity_behavior: experiments/run_case.py stores the value in RunSpec and the run manifest.
finding.request_behavior: OpenRouterAgentRunner.request_options sends model, messages, tools, tool_choice, max_tokens, reasoning, and provider policy, but no seed; _agent_loop does not otherwise consume RunSpec.seed.
finding.observed_consequence: The recorded seed fixes episode identity and schedule order only. It does not control model sampling.

provider_capability.limitation: Provider parameter support does not by itself prove bitwise deterministic multi-turn agent trajectories; an empirical canary is still required.

still_supported: Each artifact remains bound to its recorded case, model, provider policy, runner, program, and evaluator result.
The frozen A-F and B-FSR runs remain descriptive paired realizations on the same cases.
Mechanism events such as clean-replay failure, certification, and hash-matched submission remain directly observable.
The consumed-case certified-incumbent batch can qualify implementation invariants and mechanism activation.
not_supported: A-F and B-FSR are deterministic same-seed counterfactual trajectories.
A single paired realization estimates a stable treatment effect on success or resource use.
Re-running an episode with its recorded seed will reproduce the same model decisions under the current runner.

current_batch_policy.action: Do not modify or restart the frozen three-episode batch after execution has begun.
current_batch_policy.claim_boundary: Use it only for implementation and mechanism qualification, never for a generalization or effect-size claim.

required_before_formal_evaluation: Forward RunSpec.seed to every OpenRouter chat-completion request for the episode.
Record the requested seed in generation metadata and the redacted request contract.
Run a fixed-prompt, fixed-tool-free DeepInfra canary to measure same-seed repeatability and different-seed variation.
Use multiple independent episode seeds and randomized or counterbalanced arm order even if the canary is deterministic.
Report seed support and observed repeatability separately from statistical replication.
algorithm_scope: This is an evaluation-protocol correction, not an additional EnvSolve-Pro deployment mechanism.
